question: The process of covering the bare ground between plants with a layer of organic matter, to retain soil moisture is known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**mulching.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of covering the bare ground between plants with a layer of organic matter, to retain soil moisture is known as **mulching**.

 
• The material used for covering is called as **'Mulch.'**
 
• Mulching is usually practiced when cultivating commercially important **crops, fruit trees, vegetables, flowers, nursery saplings, etc.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Composting is an aerobic method of decomposing organic solid wastes. It can therefore be used to recycle organic material.
 
• Green manuring is the practice of turning into the soil undecomposed green plant tissue. 
 
 
• The function of a green manure crop is to add organic matter to the soil.
